measurement.name: Kuroshio Extension
measurement.range_interpretation: One approximate regional background value; no numerical uncertainty, range, confidence interval, annual extrema or seasonal observations supplied.
measurement.geographic_scope: Intense Kuroshio Extension jet in monthly mean fields, extending eastward from Japan to the date line; no transverse boundary coordinates extracted.
measurement.section_orientation: Author-reported meridional width; not assumed normal to the meandering jet.
measurement.layer: Surface SSH and geostrophic velocity context; no fixed vertical width layer supplied.
measurement.time_convention: Monthly mean fields summarized in source prose; no dated width series extracted. January 2005 is the illustrative Figure 1b field.
measurement.boundary_rule: Author-reported meridional jet width. Continuous SSH contours and peak velocity locate the axis; no paired width edges or threshold resolved.
measurement.source_citation: Sasaki, Y. N., S. Minobe and N. Schneider (2013), Decadal Response of the Kuroshio Extension Jet to Rossby Waves: Observation and Thin-Jet Theory, JPO 43(2):442–456, doi:10.1175/JPO-D-12-096.1.
measurement.source_locator: Printed p445 / PDF page 5, section 3 first paragraph; data/methods pp443–444; Figure 1 printed p444 / PDF page 4.
measurement.extraction_method: Approximate width transcribed from visually inspected original; no contour, coordinate or velocity-profile digitization.
measurement.phase_label: Meridional jet width in monthly mean fields
measurement.source_quality_note: Monthly mean is a temporal operator, not a recovered month-by-month width series. The separate 200 km climatological meridional scale has different support; it is not an interval endpoint.
remaining_gates: Resolve a reproducible meridional width boundary rule and exact transverse support.
Extract dated compatible sections before seasonal dimensions or playback.

climatological_scale_context.source_locator: Printed p445, section 3 first paragraph / Figure 1a

original_regional_context.display_caption: Monthly mean fields · approximate 100 km meridional jet width, extending to the date line. No dated width series, numerical uncertainty, paired edges or annual range extracted.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: Separate context: the climatological jet has a reported 200 km meridional scale from Japan to 165°E. Different temporal and geographic supports; no 100–200 km seasonal range. Farther downstream, shifts of the narrow jet broaden its long-term mean. January 2005 illustrates a monthly SSH field; 60–120 cm contours locate the axis search region, not width edges.
